instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. On a sunny city street with historic buildings, the woman in a striped t-shirt and blue jeans (R1) stands on the left wearing yellow sunglasses, smiling as she places her hand on the shoulder of the man in a patterned white shirt (R2). The man (R2) stands on the right wearing round sunglasses. Both look toward the right in profile. Bright natural sunlight casts soft shadows, creating a warm, cheerful atmosphere.
elements: R1 places her hand on R2's shoulder
R2 is the person receiving the shoulder touch from R1
R1 initiates the shoulder contact rather than R2
R1 and R2 stand together while R1 rests her hand on R2's shoulder
R2 remains standing as the recipient of R1's shoulder contact
